nodes.name: service_packages_exception.dart
nodes.summary: Domain exception type for the service-packages lookup flow, with named factory constructors for server, network, and unexpected error cases.

nodes.name: ServicePackagesException
nodes.summary: Exception carrying a human-readable message, with factories for server error, network error, and unexpected error scenarios.

nodes.name: i_book_service_repository.dart
nodes.summary: Repository interface defining the contract for fetching service packages for a vehicle and creating maintenance appointments.

nodes.name: IBookServiceRepository
nodes.summary: Abstract repository contract with getPackagesForVehicle and createAppointment methods used by booking use cases.

nodes.name: create_appointment_use_case.dart
nodes.summary: Use case that creates a maintenance appointment by delegating to the book-service repository with booking date, location, vehicle, and slot details.

nodes.name: CreateAppointmentUseCase
nodes.summary: Callable use case wrapping IBookServiceRepository.createAppointment with all appointment booking parameters.

nodes.name: get_packages_for_vehicle_use_case.dart
nodes.summary: Use case that fetches available service packages for a given customer's vehicle, optionally filtered by category.

nodes.name: GetPackagesForVehicleUseCase
nodes.summary: Callable use case wrapping IBookServiceRepository.getPackagesForVehicle.

nodes.name: book_maintanance_screen.dart
nodes.summary: Large multi-step booking screen implementing a horizontal stepper flow (car -> service package -> location -> technician -> slot -> confirm) for scheduling a maintenance appointment, including skeleton loading states and Riverpod-driven state management.
nodes.languageNotes: Single 1800+ line StatefulWidget file combining the screen, multiple skeleton placeholder widgets, and the stepper state class with dozens of private builder/handler methods — a strong candidate for splitting into smaller widgets.

nodes.name: BookServiceScreen
nodes.summary: Top-level StatefulWidget entry point for the book-service flow; creates the stepper state.

nodes.name: _HorizontalStepperScreenState
nodes.summary: Core State class driving the multi-step booking wizard: tracks selected car, service package, location, technician, and slot; fetches packages/technicians/slots; validates each step; and submits the final appointment.

nodes.name: _CarStepSkeletonList
nodes.summary: Skeleton placeholder list shown while the user's cars are loading on the car-selection step.

nodes.name: _CarStepSkeleton
nodes.summary: Single skeleton card mimicking a car list item's layout during loading.

nodes.name: _ServicePackagesSkeletonList
nodes.summary: Skeleton placeholder list shown while service packages are loading on the service-selection step.

nodes.name: _ServicePackageSkeleton
nodes.summary: Single skeleton card mimicking a service package list tile during loading.

nodes.name: _TechnicianGridSkeleton
nodes.summary: Skeleton placeholder grid shown while technicians are loading on the technician-selection step.

nodes.name: _TechnicianCardSkeleton
nodes.summary: Single skeleton card mimicking a technician summary card during loading.

nodes.name: _SlotChipsSkeleton
nodes.summary: Skeleton placeholder row of chips shown while technician time slots are loading.

nodes.name: _ensureCustomerId
nodes.summary: Resolves and caches the current customer's id from stored auth, showing an error snackbar if the user is unauthenticated.

nodes.name: _fetchPackagesForSelectedCar
nodes.summary: Triggers fetching of service packages for the currently selected car and category via the service-packages view model.

nodes.name: _buildCategoryBanner
nodes.summary: Renders the banner showing a preselected service category with an option to clear it, re-fetching packages on change.

nodes.name: _fetchTechniciansForSelection
nodes.summary: Resolves the selected package's service id and triggers a technician search for that service and location.

nodes.name: _resetBookingFlow
nodes.summary: Resets all wizard selections (car, service, location, technician, slot) back to their initial state after a successful booking.

nodes.name: _applyPreselectedCar
nodes.summary: Applies a car that was preselected from another screen (e.g. home) and immediately fetches its service packages.

nodes.name: _fetchSlotsForTechnician
nodes.summary: Fetches available appointment time slots for a chosen technician on the selected date.

nodes.name: _pickSlotDate
nodes.summary: Opens a date picker constrained to today or later and refetches technician slots for the chosen date.

nodes.name: _goToNext
nodes.summary: Validates the current wizard step (car, service, location, or technician) and advances to the next step, fetching dependent data as needed.

nodes.name: _handleBooking
nodes.summary: Validates all booking inputs, submits the create-appointment request, shows a confirmation dialog, refreshes upcoming services, and resets the flow.

nodes.name: _buildCarStep
nodes.summary: Builds the car-selection step UI: loading skeleton, empty state, or list of the user's cars with selection handling.

nodes.name: _buildServiceStep
nodes.summary: Builds the service-package-selection step UI including the category banner, loading/error/empty states, and the list of selectable packages.

nodes.name: _buildLocationStep
nodes.summary: Builds the map-based location-selection step UI using flutter_map, allowing the user to tap to choose a service location.

nodes.name: _buildTechnicianStep
nodes.summary: Builds the technician-selection step UI showing a grid of available technicians with loading/error/empty states.

nodes.name: _buildTechnicianGrid
nodes.summary: Lays out the grid of technician cards for the technician-selection step.

nodes.name: _buildTechnicianCard
nodes.summary: Builds an individual selectable technician summary card with avatar, name, rating, and selection indicator.

nodes.name: _buildTechnicianSlotsSection
nodes.summary: Builds the section showing available time slots for the selected technician, including loading and retry states.

nodes.name: _buildSlotChips
nodes.summary: Renders the row of selectable time-slot chips for the chosen technician.

nodes.name: _requestCurrentLocation
nodes.summary: Requests device location permission and retrieves the current GPS position to center the map.

nodes.name: service_packages_state.dart
nodes.summary: Sealed state hierarchy (initial, loading, loaded, empty, error) representing the result of fetching service packages for the booking flow.

nodes.name: service_packages_view_model.dart
nodes.summary: Riverpod StateNotifier that fetches service packages for a vehicle, emitting loading/loaded/empty/error states and mapping exceptions to user-facing messages.

nodes.name: ServicePackagesViewModel
nodes.summary: StateNotifier<ServicePackagesState> exposing fetchPackages and reset, used by the booking screen to drive the service-selection step.

nodes.name: book_service_provider.dart
nodes.summary: Riverpod provider wiring for the book-service feature: data source, repository, use cases, the service-packages view model, and a preselected-car provider used to jump into booking from other screens.
